info.name: Talk stickers
info.summary: Stickers for Talk: from the Smart Picker, or shared from your phone
info.description:
Send stickers in Talk (and wherever the Smart Picker is offered): open-licensed emoji packs (Fluent Emoji, Noto Emoji, also animated, OpenMoji, Twemoji) and your own, uploaded as images to a shared folder.
A sticker is sent as a link, which Talk shows as the image. On phones, whose Talk apps have no Smart Picker, the app's own page (to add to the home screen) shares a sticker to Talk as an image, and a message "/sticker party" (or an emoji) becomes the sticker in every Talk client. With the GIPHY integration, "/gif <words>" sends a GIF the same way.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
